Drone attack on Taman port oil terminal, 3 killed
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff said units of the Defence Forces hit the Tamannaftogaz oil terminal in Volna (Taman port) overnight on 22 January; explosions and fire were recorded and the extent of damage was "being clarified". The same statement listed radar stations in Crimea (59N6-E, 55Zh6, 55Zh6M), a drone depot in Kherson Oblast, a 76th Air Assault Division command post near Selydove and a logistics-brigade ammunition depot at Debaltseve. No executing unit or drone model was named.

records.name: Drone attack on Penzanefteprodukt oil depot in Penza
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Militarnyi reports the drones hit around 04:00 on 23 January while local authorities blamed "falling debris". Satellite imagery (Planet Labs, published by Radio Svoboda) shows at least one fuel tank destroyed and neighbouring tanks heat-damaged; the fire burned for more than two days. The strike was later confirmed by the General Staff.

records.name: Drone attack on refinery in Slavyansk-na-Kubani
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): General Staff statement of 26 January: explosions were recorded near the target and elements of the primary oil-processing unit were reportedly hit; the scale of damage was "being clarified". Same statement: logistics depots in occupied Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia, a UAV control point near Velyka Novosilka and troop concentrations near Yunakivka and Kolisnykivka.

records.name: Drone attack on Khokholskaya oil depot
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): General Staff (Telegram): a fire of oil products was confirmed at the depot, with thick smoke; results "being clarified". Same statement: a Russian drone warehouse and control centre, manpower concentrations near Velyka Novosilka, Shakhove, Hryhorivka, Huliaipole and Kolotylivka, an ammunition depot near Nyzhnya Duvanka and a battalion command post near Berezove. Executing unit and drone model not named.

records.name: Missile strike on Michurinskaya CHP plant in Belgorod
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Governor Gladkov confirmed that energy-sector enterprises and equipment at one Belgorod enterprise were damaged and that demining and emergency repairs began; the attacker was not named. Russian monitoring channels counted about 25 missiles fired toward Belgorod; no missile type is given. The plant (GT Energo, 24.2 MW / 80 Gcal/h) mainly supplies the Belenergomash-BZEM works.

records.name: HIMARS strike on Belgorodskaya CHP plant cuts power and heating
Drone attack on electrical substation near Khomutovka
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Kursk Governor Khinshtein blamed Ukrainian drones for the strike on an energy facility at Khomutovka (115 settlements and 11,000+ consumers lost power); no Ukrainian unit or official claimed it. Stays N/A.

records.name: 35 coal wagons derail in Magdagachinsky, probably sabotage
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. The Investigative Committee (transport) says the circumstances of the derailment of 30+ coal wagons at km 7447 of the Gudachi-Gonzha section are still being established; no claim of responsibility and no Ukrainian involvement stated. Stays N/A.

records.name: Fire at ODK-Salyut plant in Moscow
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Moscow emergency services gave no cause; the Telegram channel "112" suggested technological equipment ignited; no attack, drone or arson is stated. Stays N/A.

records.name: Drone attack on Nevinnomyssky Azot plant
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Militarnyi and Euromaidan Press say "Ukrainian Defence Forces" struck the plant on 14 January, with fire footage from the Supernova+ channel, but quote no unit or official statement (the General Staff confirmation found in searches concerns the 4 December 2025 strike). Stays N/A.

records.name: Fire at Voskresensk mineral fertilizers chemical plant
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra and other Russian channels reported smoke and fire at the plant on 16-17 January, cause "unknown", no official information; no Ukrainian unit claimed it. Stays N/A.

records.name: Substation fire in Serpukhov leaves part of city without power
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. The local head, Alexey Shimko, called the fire at the "Oka" substation an accident (24 power cables damaged, 46 diesel generators deployed); no attack or claim stated. Stays N/A.

records.name: Drone attack on Oryol CHP plant causes power outages
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Reports (Astra, Governor Klychkov) mention minor damage to fuel and energy infrastructure and partial power and water outages in the Severny and Zheleznodorozhny districts of Oryol; no party claimed it on the record and the drone type is not stated. (A Navy Neptune strike on the same CHP plant was announced on 31 October 2025 - a different event.) Stays N/A.

records.name: Russian air defense missile hits residential building in Novaya Adygeya
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): not a Ukrainian strike. Analysts cited by iStories (ASTRA, Ruslan Leviev, Yan Matveev) say footage shows a Russian air-defence missile that went astray while countering a drone raid on the evening of 20 January; local authorities described a drone strike. Remains were found under the rubble, 13 people were reported injured and 12 buildings damaged. Stays N/A.

records.name: Seven empty tank wagons derail in Bogoroditsky
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Four empty tank cars in the middle of a 71-car train bound for Yelets derailed between Zhdanka and Tovarkovo; preliminary cause: a sudden drop in brake-system pressure (360.ru); the governor reported no casualties and no sabotage claim exists. Stays N/A.

records.name: 20 coal wagons derail in Korfovsky
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. 20 coal wagons overturned at Korfovskaya station; a criminal case was opened under Article 263(1) (rail-safety violation, negligence); no sabotage or claim stated. Stays N/A.
